## Final Accepted Amendments

### `fr-2-cfc6f6b8`

`CalibrationRun::finish()` computes `overall_status` only from `checkpoint_rows` and then ignores the `Result` from `self.inner.finish()` (`crates/tank_harness/src/calibration.rs:321-338`). Because callers can reach the shared harness through `CalibrationRun::inner_mut()` (`crates/tank_harness/src/calibration.rs:251-253`), and the harness exposes additional failure paths such as `assert_snapshot()` and `record_failure()` (`crates/tank_harness/src/lib.rs:580-614`), a calibration run can accumulate real harness failures while the returned `ScenarioRow` still says `pass` and omits `artifact_path`. `finish()` should propagate or incorporate underlying harness failures instead of dropping them.
